milestones.title: Backtester
milestones.description: Built a backtesting tool that fetches historical prices, runs four strategies in parallel (trend follower, contrarian RSI, adaptive range trader, and buy-and-hold baseline), and renders a dashboard with equity curves, side-by-side metrics (return, max drawdown, Sharpe, win rate, profit factor), and a trade log. Focus: using max drawdown to force honest risk assessment.
milestones.reflection: Seeing equity curves side-by-side made it obvious which strategies win because of conditions vs. luck.

milestones.title: Value-betting parlay automator
milestones.description: Built an end-to-end pipeline that loads config + credentials, logs in, scrapes events and odds, matches selections to a probability file, computes EV (EV = p·odds − 1), filters positive-EV picks, and places one parlay per run. Includes a fallback mode that still runs end-to-end by choosing a "favorite" per event when no probability model is available.
milestones.reflection: Keeping the system as pure transformations over one selection shape made the logic testable and easy to reason about.
